coreCollectionExclusionReason: This is a product/e-commerce launch rather than a verified local jewelry business; jewelry is not one of the ten core niches.

source.name: Taya official website
source.rightsEvidence: Requester attestation covers persistent full-page screenshot and derived-prompt retention, including use of screenshots as pipeline visual references. No owner grant was uploaded or independently verified; scope is limited to this internal reference-library use.

provenance.capture: Full-page captures from the live official domain at desktop 1440x1000 and mobile 390x844. Captures include first-party page imagery only as part of the screenshot evidence. Lazy imagery was triggered by scrolling before capture.
provenance.attribution: Source brand and wordmark remain visible only as part of the original-site screenshots. Derived prompt describes transferable mechanics and prohibits reuse of brand assets, copy, and trade dress.
provenance.qa: Both viewports had document and body widths equal to the viewport. All seven observed image elements completed successfully after scrolling; no broken image URL was observed.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A product-led wearable story that sells an expressive jewelry object before explaining its technology. A narrow wordmark/navigation sits over an immersive close-cropped campaign image; the promise and preorder action are embedded in the image composition. The page then uses a suspended pendant and fine chain as a visual connector into concise editorial context, a lifestyle-film chapter, a jewelry-first product story, four image-backed product attributes, a deliberate-activation/privacy explanation, a testimonial rail, and a compact footer. The reference is airy and product-focused rather than a standard ecommerce category grid.

heroGeometry.alignment: full-width photograph with promise low-left and compact supporting sentence low-right; utility actions at the upper edge
heroGeometry.viewport: opening campaign image occupies roughly the first 40 percent of the full-page desktop capture; wordmark, product promise, and preorder action remain legible in the opening

navigationGeometry.mode: minimal wordmark and compact utility navigation
navigationGeometry.placement: lightweight overlay at the top edge of the campaign image
navigationGeometry.mobile: small logo and hamburger over a full-width image; menu content opens separately without competing with the product image

typography.scale: large but compact campaign title, small uppercase utility labels, short body paragraphs, and restrained button text

palette.contrastIntent: low-chroma product luxury with dark text and controls held to clear contrast

imageTreatment.mode: natural-light campaign portrait, isolated pendant still life, and lifestyle use-case photography
imageTreatment.crop: wide close crop for the opening; narrow product still-life crops; stacked portrait and detail panels on mobile
imageTreatment.focalPoint: wearable product on a person or a single pendant; never crop the product out to protect decorative atmosphere

servicePresentation.pattern: product education rather than service cards: one wearable object is introduced, then its design and technical attributes are explained in an image-backed four-part rail
servicePresentation.interaction: feature details stay short and scannable; any carousel remains operable with visible controls and a static fallback

ctaPlacement.primary: preorder or product action in the upper campaign image and again after product context
ctaPlacement.early: inside the opening image composition, not postponed to the footer

motion.primitive: fine chain or pendant line used as a visual connector, restrained image reveal, and horizontally navigable testimonial rail
motion.library: source implementation library is not asserted; preserve mechanics with CSS or a vetted motion layer
motion.reducedMotion: render a static chain illustration, show all features and testimonials in reading order, disable autoplay and scroll-linked transforms

rules: keep logo and menu controls in a compact top strip
let the campaign image occupy the full content width with legible overlay copy
make the pendant connector a short visual pause between image and editorial copy
stack feature images with readable labels
keep purchase and how-it-works actions reachable without sideways scrolling

prohibitedPatterns: copying Taya name, wordmark, logo, product silhouette, exact source text, imagery, testimonials, or trade dress
inventing battery duration, materials, water resistance, audio quality, privacy behavior, preorder dates, price, or technical specifications
presenting generated or stock people as the client's staff or customers
scroll lock or motion that hides product information
placing the only purchase action in the footer

requiredSignatureElements.description: an image-first campaign opening where the wearable product and concise product promise share the same composition
a fine-line product or necklace motif that visually links the campaign to a concise editorial product explanation
a small sequence of image-backed product attributes that explains design before technical detail
a distinct privacy or activation explanation based only on verified client-provided product facts

acceptanceChecks: desktop opening reads as a wearable campaign rather than a generic split hero
mobile keeps product image, promise, and primary action visible without horizontal overflow
client-provided image assets outrank generated placeholders
all product specifications and privacy claims are sealed verified facts
the technical feature sequence remains understandable without animation
reference imagery and source copy are not emitted into the generated site
all image and motion elements have descriptive text and reduced-motion behavior

review.scope: Official-domain screenshots, source-derived visual mechanics, responsive review, and requester-attested internal model-reference use; no owner grant file was provided.
